name: data-profile
description: Generate a complete, manuscript-ready data profile: demographics summary table, scale identification with reliability (alpha, omega, CFA), comprehensive codebook, sample characteristics, and measurement documentation — all following current best practices at the time of execution. Searches for the latest reporting standards (JARS, TOP, APA) before generating output. Produces everything a Methods section needs to describe the data. Use when the user says "describe my data for the manuscript," "demographics table," "what scales are in here," "codebook," "Methods section data," "sample characteristics," or any time they need data documented for publication. Triggers on "profile," "demographics," "scales," "codebook," "sample description," "Methods section."
